criteria.evidence: The status test exercises approved status and ordering. skills/speck-build/SKILL.md instructs log completion and committing, but its test checks only the status instruction and absence of PR commands; it does not verify the required logs and commit.
scripts/speck.mjs: shipChecks uses an endpoint git diff, which misses changes subsequently reverted. runTests returns true when no test command exists. Existing refusal tests cover neither case.
shipTicket implements done status, --no-ff merge, branch deletion and conflict rollback. Supplied integration tests exercise successful shipping, conflict recovery and invocation from main.
shipTicket and doctorChecks implement remote pushing and optional gh. Supplied tests exercise successful and refused pushes, no remote and optional GitHub CLI.
The ship skill invokes speck ship and sets disable-model-invocation: true. The supplied AC5 test checks the skills, brief and generated AGENTS.md pointer.

findings.issue: shipChecks compares only the reviewed and current trees. A commit changing code followed by a revert passes, although criterion 2 forbids any post-review commit changing files outside speck/.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect changed paths across every commit after the reviewed commit, including merge commits. Add a regression test with a code change followed by its revert.

findings.issue: runTests treats an unset test command as success and permits shipping without passing tests, contrary to criterion 2.
findings.suggested_fix: Refuse shipping when commands.test is empty, explain how to configure it, and test that branch, ticket and working tree remain unchanged.

findings.issue: The AC1 build test does not cover the required review log, delivery log or approval commit. These parts of the criterion remain unverified.
findings.suggested_fix: Add appropriate verification of the complete approval close-out procedure, including both logs and the ticket-branch commit.

product_md.note: The claimed mandatory passing tests and protection against post-review code changes are stronger than the implementation.

verdict.summary: The local shipping workflow has useful integration coverage, including merge conflicts and failed pushes. It needs fixes before merge: shipping can proceed without a test command and overlooks code changes that were later reverted. Build close-out also needs fuller verification. Sandbox startup failed, so this review relies on the supplied diff and test output.
